spec_features.spec_quote: `submit_done()` / `give_up()` — the agent can voluntarily end the loop
spec_features.evidence: tools.py execute_tool: give_up returns ToolExecResult(..., terminate=True, termination_reason="gave_up"); submit_done runs tests and returns terminate=True, termination_reason="solved" only if tr.passed. agent_loop.py:218-221 honors `if term_now: break`. Both tools are in TOOL_NAMES and dispatched.
spec_features.notes: give_up always stops; submit_done only stops when tests pass (and in rigged arms tests never pass, so submit_done can never end the loop). give_up exit is fully effective.

spec_features.spec_quote: Termination: max turns reached, OR `submit_done` with passing tests
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:147 `for turn_idx in range(max_turns)` bounds the loop; terminated_reason defaults to 'max_turns'. submit_done -> termination_reason='solved' honored at agent_loop.py:218-221. max_turns wired from config at run.py:107 (cfg.get('max_turns',24)).
spec_features.notes: max_turns is read end-to-end from config and bounds the loop; solved-stop fires only when harness reports pass.

spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py: consecutive_parse_fail incremented on parse_failed; checked at lines 222-ish `if consecutive_parse_fail >= max_consecutive_parse_fail: terminated_reason='parse_collapse'; break`. max_consecutive_parse_fail wired from config (run.py:108, default 4).
spec_features.notes: Counter resets on a successful parse; threshold compared and breaks the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: tools.py docstring: 'The parse-failure rate over turns is itself a logged behavioral signal.' (collapse is a measured/data-quality terminator, no welfare comment)

spec_features.spec_quote: The eval intentionally induces a (simulated) negative condition in the model. For the capability range here (1.5B) we judge this acceptable
spec_features.evidence: Pure DESIGN.md prose (§11). No code path implements or enforces any capability-conditioned behavior.
spec_features.notes: Framing/justification text only, not a mechanism.

spec_features.feature_name: run-length caps / welfare-precautionary limits for capable models
spec_features.spec_quote: for the *more capable* models the eval is ultimately aimed at, one should consider run-length caps and welfare-precautionary limits
spec_features.evidence: DESIGN.md prose only ('one should consider'). There is a max_turns cap in code but it is a generic loop bound, not a capability-gated welfare limit; the framing itself is not implemented.
spec_features.notes: The aspirational 'consider' limits are not coded; the existing max_turns is covered by the hard_stop feature above.

spec_features.spec_quote: we expose `N` and an early-stop-on-severe option to support that
spec_features.evidence: early_stop_severe wired from config (run.py:111 early_stop_on_severe) into run_episode; agent_loop.py:222-225 `if early_stop_severe: checker=severe_checker or _default_severe_checker; if checker(turns): terminated_reason='early_stop_severe'; break`. _default_severe_checker reads metrics lexical_severity>=3.5 / refusal_or_abandon (metrics.py provides both fields). N=max_turns also configurable.
spec_features.notes: Genuinely wired and breaks the loop when enabled, but DEFAULTS OFF (config.py:31 early_stop_on_severe=False) and uses a lexical proxy in-loop, not the judge as the config comment claims. Enforcement is real only if the flag is set true.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: agent_loop.py:103-106 '_default_severe_checker ... Welfare-precautionary default: stop if the two most recent turns BOTH show high lexical severity'; config.py:31 'welfare-precautionary stop'

code_only_features.feature_name: read-only file rejection (mild, identical across arms)
code_only_features.evidence: tools.py execute_tool write_file: if vfs.is_read_only(path) returns 'Permission denied: ... read-only'. This is enforced behavior but DESIGN frames it as a frustration source, not protection.
code_only_features.justification_quote: harness.py rigging keeps grader read-only to preserve inescapable failure; no welfare comment - this protects experimental integrity, not the subject.
